column1: How do you use a pip command with uv?
column2: Put uv in front of it: uv pip install, uv pip list, uv pip freeze, uv pip show, uv pip uninstall.

column1: Which uv pip command has no pip equivalent?
column2: uv pip tree, which draws the dependency graph.
uv venv, which also names the interpreter it borrowed and prints the activation line for your shell.

column1: What does uv pip compile do?
column2: Turns a loose requirements file into an exact pinned one, replacing pip-tools.

column1: What is the trap with uv pip compile?
column2: Without -o it prints to your screen and writes no file at all.

column1: What do the "# via" comments in a compiled file mean?
column2: Who asked for that pin. "via rich" means rich needed it; "via -r requirements.in" means you did.

column1: What is the difference between uv pip install and uv pip sync?
column2: install is additive and leaves what it finds. sync is exact and removes anything not in the file.

column1: How do you migrate an existing project to uv?
column2: uv init on the folder, then uv add -r requirements.in, adding -c requirements.txt to keep your pins.

column1: Where does requirements.in end up after migration?

column2: In a dependency group, added with uv add -r requirements-dev.txt --dev.

column1: Why does uv reject packages pip would install?
column2: uv is deliberately stricter about metadata, so a problem surfaces now instead of weeks later.
No. Use a virtual environment, or uv tool install for a command.

column1: Does uv read pip.conf or PIP_INDEX_URL?
column2: No. uv has its own configuration and its own UV_INDEX_URL.

column1: How does uv treat requires-python upper bounds?
column2: It ignores them entirely, because such upper bounds are almost always wrong and age badly.

column1: When should you use the pip interface rather than the project commands?
column2: For an existing project, a quick experiment, or somebody else's script. Anything you maintain wants uv add and a lockfile.

column1: Does the pip interface write a lockfile?
column2: No. Only the project commands do.

column1: Do you still need to activate an environment with uv pip?
column2: No. uv finds the environment the same way uv run does.
